# Reference calendar

`aladhan-jakarta-2026-09.json` is an actual AlAdhan response retrieved during
implementation on 2026-09-08. Calendar: September 2026, latitude -6.2, longitude
106.8, method 20, school 0, timezone Asia/Jakarta, latitudeAdjustmentMethod 3,
all nine tune offsets zero. Retained for reproducible offline validation of
parsing and comparison across 150 prayer times. It is not an official published
Kemenag timetable and is never loaded as runtime data.

Endpoint: https://api.aladhan.com/v1/calendar/2026/9
